name: idempotent-payments-p2
prompt: how do I stop a customer from being charged twice if they double-click pay or the request is retried

chunks.content: the checkout page disables the pay button visually after the first click
the card form rejects an expired expiry date and flags a failed Luhn check before submit
a refund reverses the captured charge and emails the customer a confirmation
round currency amounts to the smallest unit to avoid fractional-cent drift
the fraud service blocks a charge when too many distinct cards are tried from one device
we capture the funds only after the gateway webhook confirms authorization
generate a PDF receipt and attach it to the order
compute tax per jurisdiction at the time of sale
indexed orders on customer id for the history page
decided that every charge request must carry a client-generated idempotency key, and a repeat with the same key returns the original result instead of charging again
store each idempotency key with its outcome in a unique-constrained table, so a duplicate submission collides and we replay the saved response rather than re-billing
insert the payment intent in the same transaction that records the key, so a retried double-click cannot create a second charge row for the same order
expire stored idempotency keys after 24 hours since a legitimate retry never arrives that late, while a fresh purchase of the same cart uses a new key
render order dates in the customer's locale
